findings.explanation: Claim says 'clinically proven to fade dark spots by 60% in just 2 weeks': 60% is more than the 32% in the evidence; 2 weeks is faster than the 8 weeks in the evidence. FACT-014 says Vitamin C Brightening Serum gave a 32% reduction in visible dark spots over 8 weeks (in-house study, 48 participants).
